Daria: Heads up — after rebasing feature/async-prefetch onto main, CI is red on integration shard 4. Looks like grpc timeouts. Anyone able to help bisect?
ci-bot: Build 25432 failed on shard-4. Failing test: tests/integration/test_kv_shard_quorum.py::test_kv_recovery. Failure rate: ~12% across reruns. https://ci.internal/runs/25432
Ryan: I can look in ~30m. Can you paste the failing logs? @Marta fyi in case it's infra-related.
Daria: Log snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 200, got 502
grpc._channel._Rendezvous: <_Rendezvous of RPC that terminated with:
	status = StatusCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
	details = "Deadline Exceeded"
>
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/test_kv_shard_quorum.py", line 87, in test_kv_recovery
    assert resp.status == 200
```
Marta: This looks like the same grpc deadline flake we saw yesterday. Main bumped RPC_TIMEOUT_MS from 200 -> 500 in commit 9f4c. If your branch didn't pick that up, under CI load the shorter timeout can surface. Try re-running with `RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=500` or merge main.
Oliver: Also check for the transport change — `transport/conn_pool.py` had backoff tweaks. Grep for `RPC_TIMEOUT_MS` and `BACKOFF_` vars. Could be combinatorial.
Daria: Confirmed main had the timeout bump, I missed it during rebase. I'll merge that commit, kick off a rerun, and start a local bisect if it still fails. Thanks :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Rerun queued by daria — build 25435.
Daria: Quick update: local bisect points to commit a1b2c3 (author: @hugo) that reintroduced a scheduling race under high concurrency. Filing PR to revert and add retry/backoff test. Will follow up in the PR thread for tracking.
